label: organization located or based in
definition: Organization 1 is based in or has a geographic office/site in place 2.
scope_notes: Firm/company-in and based-in paths qualify. Nationality adjectives alone remain ambiguous between geographic base and ownership/origin. Individual professionals, agencies as employers and sectors are other predicates.

facts.reason: Yankee Group is explicitly a firm/company in Boston and based there.
International Data Corporation is explicitly a firm/company/organization based in Framingham.
Forrester Research is explicitly a firm/company in and based in Cambridge.
The be-at and garden-at paths establish a Richmond Terrace location, but do not settle whether Snug Harbor is an organization/institutional site or only a geographic place.
facts.reviewer_question: Does Snug Harbor here denote an institution or organizational venue based at Richmond Terrace, or merely a geographic harbor/place?

facts.reason: Morningstar is explicitly a publisher and tracker in Chicago.
